findings.label: Orphaned Javadoc on locationExpr
findings.detail: instanceTypeExpr's Javadoc was inserted between locationExpr's doc comment and locationExpr itself, so the 'Where traffic came from or went to' comment and its @param direction attach to nothing and locationExpr (:1669) is undocumented. Move the comment back down to the method it describes. Inherited from the parked base work rather than written in this build.

findings.label: Empty-month copy is basis-blind
findings.detail: On the amortized basis a month whose rows are all commitment fees nets to zero per group, is dropped by the HAVING, and the card asserts 'No charges found for {monthLabel}.' while the amortized note is suppressed by the same isEmpty gate. Check whether charges === [] is reachable on amortized for an account with fees and no covered usage; if so, say 'nothing is listed on this basis' there.

findings.label: Blocked-basis sentence sits under the popover
findings.detail: The aria-describedby paragraph and the explanation popover are both absolute top-full right-0, and the popover is opaque at z-20, so opening the explanation while amortized is blocked hides the sentence explaining why. Offset one of the two. Visual only; the accessible description path is unaffected.

findings.label: Ledger cache-key prefix exercised but not asserted
findings.detail: The table drives insightPrefix over gcp-/azure- but asserts nothing about the ledger's cache key, so round-3 MEDIUM #5's requested assertion is unpinned — even though the derivation at ChargesByServiceSection.tsx:915 is correct.
